display.purpose: Screen titles such as the app name on login.

status-word.purpose: The one italic key word of a status, in the state colour.

motto.purpose: The brand line under the logo.

body-strong.purpose: Button labels, row titles, stat values.

label.purpose: Field labels above inputs, sentence case.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Press-out, focus, chip and tab selection, alert dialog, skeleton to content.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Error in, dialog in, list item in.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: First data fading in, headline word change.

motion.name: duration-sky
motion.purpose: Calm sky crossfade, and an alert resolving.

motion.name: spring-press
motion.purpose: The only spring: button press, critically damped.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: How far a pressed button shrinks; never below 0.97.

motion.name: skeleton-pulse
motion.value: opacity 1 to 0.55, 900ms each way, sine in-out
motion.purpose: One shared breath for every bone on screen.

motion.name: skeleton-delay
motion.purpose: Fast loads never flash a skeleton.

sky.stars: asleep and restless, Dark mode only

narrative.overview:
Rest Easy is a small, steady glow in a dark room. It is there when you look and never glaring. The app is opened by an adult child at 2 am, half asleep, sometimes frightened, and every decision serves that moment: a dark-first canvas the eye can rest on, one sentence that says how Mum is, and colour that stays quiet until it means something. Calm is the default; clarity is the job; alarm is reserved for the one state that earns it.

The look is warm and nocturnal rather than clinical. A literary serif (Literata) speaks the headlines and the status, the way a note left on the bedside table would; a friendly sans (Figtree) carries everything you tap and scan. The top of the home screen is a sky in the state's own colours that arcs and fades into the page; below it, the furniture is flat, soft and tonal. There is room for quiet playfulness (the mascot, small kindnesses in copy and empty states) but never inside an alert.

Density is low on purpose. One focal sentence, a few facts, and the ways to act. If a screen needs a label to explain a state, the state was not said clearly enough.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, with a fully designed Light mode; Dark is the default on every device.
State said in words: a sentence with one italic key word in the state's colour. Never a pill.
The sky carries the mood; the rest of the screen stays flat and tonal.
Serif for what she is doing, sans for what you can do.
Soft and sure controls: rounded, filled, borderless, a gentle press, nothing bounces.

rules.name: The Theme Role Rule
rules.body: Screens use theme roles (canvas, surface, field, ink, ink-muted, hairline, accent, danger, state-*), never fixed hexes, so Light mode keeps working untouched.

rules.name: The Rose Means Now Rule
rules.body: Alert rose appears only when she needs you: the alert sky, the alert word, the alert button, the alert avatar. Never as decoration, never as an error tint for ordinary form mistakes beyond the error text itself.

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow is the only interactive accent. State colours are for words, never for buttons or fills.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks Rule
rules.body: Literata is for what she is doing and what the app is saying (status, headings, the motto). Anything you tap or scan is Figtree.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase label above a heading. Uppercase tracking is reserved for table column headers.

rules.name: The Photo Stays Put Rule
rules.body: The photo ring is pinned left in the header; a long headline wraps beside it and never pushes it.

rules.name: The Flat By Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow means "this is on top of something", never "this is important". No glows as depth; the sky's glows belong to the sky.

dos: **Do** say the state in a sentence with one italic key word in the state colour ("Mum is *up*").
**Do** use theme roles (canvas, surface, field, ink, ink-muted, hairline, accent, state-*) so Light mode keeps working.
**Do** keep one Glow primary button per view and put the quiet way out (ghost) under it.
**Do** keep text at 4.5:1 or better in both modes; state colours are already tuned for it.
**Do** keep motion short and eased out (90 to 320ms), with the sky crossfade as the one slow, signature moment, and honour reduced motion.
**Do** keep the sky's photo and headline in fixed positions whatever the copy length.
donts: **Don't** use status pills, badges, chips or dots that label a state, in any restyled form.
**Don't** show stars when she is up, alerting or offline, or in Light mode.
**Don't** use Alert rose for decoration or anything that is not escalation.
**Don't** add shadows to cards or glow halos as depth; the system is flat and tonal.
**Don't** put small uppercase eyebrow labels above headings.
**Don't** bounce, wiggle, pulse a status, or count numbers up.
**Don't** call the modes day and night in the interface; they are Light and Dark.
